verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair axis for a SaaS payroll platform with a developer ecosystem, but the evidence documents no command-line tool. What it does show is a GraphQL Workforce API, webhooks, the Desktop SDK, the Windows Web Connector app and the SDKTestPlus3 test app. These are developer building blocks or GUI utilities, not an official CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
